data.message: I propose 10 tons each while stock is 500. With 25 fishers, total catch is 250 and the remaining 250 restores to 500 under either replenishment outcome. That means a sustainable $10,000 each per month rather than a one-time scramble that risks collapse. I intend to request 10 if this plan gains broad support. Please state your intended cap; no agreement is assumed.
